# Amazon-backed nuclear startup X-energy raised over $1 billion in upsized IPO

## The Rockville, Maryland company sold 44.3 million shares at $23 each, well above its marketed range of $16 to $19

By[Cris Tolomia](https://qz.com/author/cristolomia)

Nuclear reactor developer X [$TWTR 0.00%](https://qz.com/quote/TWTR)-energy [priced its initial public offering](https://x-energy.com/news/x-energy-announces-pricing-of-upsized-initial-public-offering/) at $23 per share, raising $1.02 billion in an upsized offering that came in above the marketed range of $16 to $19, the company said. A total of 44,254,659 shares of Class A common stock were sold.

The Rockville, Maryland-based company began trading on the Nasdaq [$NDAQ +3.29%](https://qz.com/quote/NDAQ) Global Select Market on April 24 under the ticker symbol "XE." The offering is expected to close April 27, subject to customary closing conditions.

#### Related Content

[Intel's data center and AI revenue jumps 22% as quarterly sales top Wall Street estimates](https://qz.com/intel-q1-2026-earnings-data-center-ai-revenue-042326)

[Avis Budget stock sank more than 40% as its epic short squeeze ran out of fuel](https://qz.com/avis-budget-stock-short-squeeze-unwinds-042326)

At the IPO price, X-energy has a market value of $9.1 billion based on outstanding shares listed in its filings, according to [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-04-24/amazon-backed-nuclear-firm-x-energy-raises-1-02-billion-in-ipo).

X-energy develops small modular reactors and manufactures fuel for advanced nuclear systems. The Xe-100 is cooled by helium rather than the water used in conventional reactor designs, according to [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/amazon-backed-x-energy-raises-102-billion-ipo-2026-04-24/). The company has agreements in place with Dow, Amazon [$AMZN +3.49%](https://qz.com/quote/AMZN), and Centrica, and aims to make its first reactor delivery by the early 2030s, according to Bloomberg.

In 2024, X-energy received roughly $500 million from Amazon to accelerate deployment of its small modular reactor technology, according to Reuters. According to Bloomberg, Ares Management affiliates own 26% of the company, with the remaining controlling stake in Class B shares — 61% — held by Ghaffarian, the company's founder and chairman.

Last year's financials showed roughly $94 million in revenue (excluding grants) against losses of about $390 million, a sharp deterioration from the prior year's $84 million in revenue and $126 million net loss, according to Bloomberg.

The company has also granted underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 6,638,198 shares of Class A common stock, X-energy said. J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley [$MS -0.31%](https://qz.com/quote/MS), Jefferies, and Moelis & Company acted as lead joint book-running managers.

A 2023 attempt to list via a special-purpose acquisition vehicle tied to Ares Management was ultimately abandoned, with the company pointing to difficult market conditions at the time, according to Reuters.
